47,50: Talk to Redbeard Frank in Port Sarim.
Talk to one of the Seamen on the docks in Port Sarim to go to Musa Point.
Grab the white apron from the Fishing Shop.
Search the crate in the back room of the Port Sarim food shop. Make sure you're wearing your white apron.
Bring the Karamjan rum to Redbeard Frank in Port Sarim.
45,49: Talk to Zembo in the Karamja Wines, Spirits and Beers bar. Buy one Karamjan rum.
Pick 10 bananas nearby, and then talk to Luthas about working for him.
Put the Karamjan rum into the crate.
Right-click fill the rest of the crate with bananas, then talk to Luthas.
Talk to Luthas and tell him you finished filling the crate.
46,49: Head back to Port Sarim. Pay the Customs Officer to sail there.
50,53: Climb up the stairs in The Blue Moon Inn in Varrock.
Open the chest by using the key on it.
46,52: Dig in the middle of the cross in Falador Park, and kill the Gardener (level 4) who appears. Once killed, dig again.
